verdict.rationale: Viam documents the full loop. Built-in data capture syncs machine data to the cloud (viam-docs-51, viam-docs-7), and that data feeds cloud dataset creation, annotation and ML training (viam-docs-8). Trained models are then pushed so machines pull them automatically, with versioning, staging, rollback, OTA model updates and canary testing (viam-docs-9, viam-docs-48, viam-docs-26). Missing for 10: in-depth technical docs on the training and deployment workflow beyond marketing-level overview pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the loop works in practice.
